title: Baby's First Learning ABC
developmental_focus: Letter-shape recognition and letter-to-object vocabulary association (not reading/decoding). Ages 2-3 can begin matching a letter shape to a familiar object and its spoken first sound when read aloud by a caregiver.
safety_notes: One letter and one object per page only; no cursive or serif letterforms.
Consistent googly-eyes-and-smile character treatment applied to every letter and every object across all 26 pages.
Every object chosen is a common, unambiguous, safe word for the letter (see manuscript.md for the substitution note on K and X).
No sharp objects, no small choking-hazard-shaped items, no imagery that could read as frightening once a face is added.
